text: かねにも　なんないし　もってけよ　こんなもん！

structure.jp: かねにも　なんないし
structure.en: it won't even turn into money, so

patterns.name: 〜になる
patterns.span: かねにも　なんない
patterns.explanation: になる means 'become'; なんない is a slurred spoken form of ならない, and も adds 'even'. かねにも　なんない = 'it won't even turn into money'.

patterns.name: 〜し
patterns.explanation: し after a statement gives it as a reason, with a feeling of 'and besides'. かねにも　なんないし = 'it won't even make money, so'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: もってけ is the short spoken form of もっていけ, a blunt order made from もつ plus いく, 'hold and go'. もってけよ = 'just take it with you!'
